description: Makes a value available to every descendant of the current component under a key.
Reads the closest ancestor's provided value for a key, with an optional default.
Typed `Symbol` key: `const Key: InjectionKey<T> = Symbol()` gives `inject(Key)` the type `T | undefined`.
Passing props through intermediate components that only forward them.
Provides a value to the whole application, typically from a plugin.
